member.name: T:Microsoft.Xbox.Controls.Rune
member.summary: A single-line text entry control built for the TV: a strip of character tiles the user picks from with the controller or a Kinect hand gesture, with the entered text shown above.

remarks.para: Controller: D-pad moves across the tiles, A enters a character, X deletes the last character, the shoulder buttons (or the remote's previous/next keys) jump between letter groups, and Y closes the control when is true. Kinect: the user hovers over the strip to zoom it and then completes an engagement gesture on a tile to enter it (see and ). Tiles switch between letter, extended-letter and number/symbol sets.

While a has focus it also accepts text from a chatpad and from a companion-device keyboard, and keeps the companion keyboard in sync. It sets its own A, B, X and Y texts. Native calls go to npctrl.dll ordinals 700–702.
